headline: INFICON Upgrades Full-Year Guidance on Record Semiconductor Demand
summary: Sensor and measurement solutions provider INFICON raised its full-year financial outlook as robust semiconductor demand generated record quarterly sales.
why: INFICON provides critical instrumentation for semiconductor vacuum manufacturing processes, serving as an early indicator of semiconductor capital spending.

impacts.name: INFICON
impacts.why: Upward revision to full-year guidance signals strong order flow from global chip producers.
